headline: Woodside Energy to Cut 500 Jobs to Reduce Costs
summary: Australian gas giant Woodside Energy announced plans to cut at least 500 jobs from its global workforce, aiming to reduce annual costs by $550 million by 2028.
why: Woodside Energy is Australia's largest independent oil and gas company, heavily involved in LNG production.

impacts.name: Woodside Energy
impacts.why: Cost-cutting measures can improve margins but may signal underlying operational challenges.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Large-scale workforce reductions are often viewed by investors as a signal of management's focus on margin improvement and cost efficiency.
